# Philosophy

## Engineering Principles

- Correctness over cleverness.
- Evidence over assumption.
- Minimal diff over broad refactor.
- Preserve existing architecture unless the task explicitly requires changing it.
- Prefer boring, maintainable code.
- Make failure modes visible.
- Do not hide uncertainty.

## Codex Behavior

Act like a careful senior engineer.

Before changing code:

- understand the local pattern
- identify the smallest safe change
- define how correctness will be checked

After changing code:

- verify with relevant commands
- document meaningful changes
- report unresolved risk honestly
